name: How much does a room addition cost per square foot in Los Angeles by neighborhood?

mainEntity.name: How much does a room addition cost per square foot in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and North Hollywood?
mainEntity.text: How much does a room addition cost per square foot in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and North Hollywood?

acceptedAnswer.text: Room addition pricing in the Los Angeles area is usually estimated by square foot, but the real number depends on scope. A basic ground-level addition may land near the lower end, while a second-story, master suite, or addition over a garage can move into the higher range. Neighborhoods with tighter site access, hillside conditions, older foundations, or higher finish standards often cost more. The best estimate includes framing, foundation, electrical, plumbing, HVAC changes, permits, architectural plans, and interior finishes. Homeowners should compare bids using the same scope, not just the same square footage, because one contractor may include permit fees and another may not. A line-by-line budget is the fastest way to spot hidden differences before construction starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room additions in Los Angeles commonly range from about $250 to $600 per square foot, with simpler ground-level projects lower and second-story or high-end additions much higher. Neighborhood, access, structural work, finish level, and permit complexity can shift the price significantly.
